spans.s:
The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality which has the letter य as its penultimate and after a वृद्ध place name denoting a waste or desert place.

Terms: वुञ्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'who obtains it' after the words 1. धन and 2. गण being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction.

Terms: यत्

The affix खञ् comes in the sense of 'a place of growing when that place is a field' after the name of any particular corn being in the Genitive 6th-Case.

Terms: खञ्

The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'a desire thereafter' after the words 1. धन and 2. हिरण्य being in the Locative -7th case in construction.

Terms: कन्

The अनङ् is the substitute of the final of धनुस् in a बहुव्रीहि समास ।

Terms: अनङ्
